s1.title: Omusingi
s1.description: Okulamusa, ab’omu maka, emmere, ennamba n’essaawa, mu kibuga, awaka, olunaku lwo n’obulamu.

s2.title: Obulamu bwa buli lunaku
s2.description: Nnyonnyola ebintu, yambala, yamba awaka, ebiseera by’omwaka, ebisolo, emirimu, essomero n’entambula.

u1.title: Okulamusa
u1.description: Lamusa abantu, weeyanjule era obale okutuuka ku kkumi.

u2.title: Ab’omu maka ne mikwano
u2.description: Yogera ku b’omu maka go, gamba by’olina era onnyonnyole abantu.

u3.title: Emmere n’akatale
u3.description: Manya emmere, gamba nti olumwa enjala oba ennyonta, era ogule mu katale.

u4.title: Ennamba n’essaawa
u4.description: Bala okutuuka ku lukumi, manya essaawa mu Lungereza era oyogere ku leero n’enkya.

u5.title: Okutambula mu kibuga
u5.description: Buuza ebifo gye biri, laga ekkubo era otambule mu takisi oba boda boda.

u6.title: Awaka
u6.description: Nnyonnyola amaka go, gamba ekiriwo n’ekitaliiwo, era omanye langi.

u7.title: Olunaku lwange
u7.description: Manya ennaku za wiiki, nnyonnyola by’okola buli lunaku era oyogere ku budde.

u8.title: Omubiri n’obulamu
u8.description: Manya ebitundu by’omubiri, gamba ekikuluma, laba omusawo era oyagalize omuntu obulamu obulungi.

u9.title: Okunnyonnyola ebintu
u9.description: Gamba ebintu n’abantu bwe bali: birungi oba bibi, bipya, binene oba bitono, bizito oba byangu.

u10.title: Engoye
u10.description: Manya engoye zo, yambala okusinziira ku budde era ogule ekipya.

u11.title: Okuyamba awaka
u11.description: Saba era osabibwe: jjangu, tuula, leeta, longoosa, naaza era oyambe mu mirimu gy’awaka.

u12.title: Obudde n’ebiseera by’omwaka
u12.description: Yogera ku mpewo n’ebire, ekiseera ky’enkuba n’eky’omusana, n’obudde bwe bwali jjo.

u13.title: Ebisolo
u13.description: Ebisolo by’omu ffaamu, eby’awaka n’ebisolo by’omu nsiko.

u14.title: Emirimu
u14.description: Gamba ky’okola, buuza abalala ku mirimu gyabwe era oyogere ku musaala n’oluwummula.

u15.title: Essomero
u15.description: Ekibiina, amasomo, ebibuuzo, ebigezo n’omulimu gw’awaka.

u16.title: Entambula
u16.description: Gula tikiti, kwata eggaali y’omukka oba ennyonyi, era ogambe by’onookola.
